oracle_basis.text: Sacrifice five Treasures: Search your library for an artifact or Dragon card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Tap two untapped artifacts you control: Untap target artifact.
Creatures entering don't cause abilities to trigger.
When this creature enters, counter up to one target activated or triggered ability; qualifying source loses abilities while Tidebinder remains.

invariants: five Treasures are paid as Magda activation cost before priority
removing Magda does not erase an already-stacked Magda activation
Clock taps two untapped artifacts as activation cost before priority
removing Clock does not erase an already-stacked Clock activation
Tidebinder may counter Magda or Clock activated abilities when its ETB trigger exists
Torpor Orb suppresses Tidebinder's enters-trigger entirely
noncreature permanent removal can remove Torpor Orb without relying on a creature ETB
removing Torpor Orb while the target activation remains on stack can reopen a later Tidebinder ETB window
countering an activation does not refund costs already paid
